head: DAY 2.
*THE MARKET TESTED ME.*
scenes.say: Day two. Yesterday my system came alive. Today, the market tested my rules.

head: HEXA,
*WHAT DID GOLD DO?*
scenes.say: Hexa, what did gold do today?

head: GOLD HIT *$3,685*
THEN *~$3,620*
scenes.say: Gold ran to about three thousand six hundred eighty five during London. When New York opened, it dropped around sixty dollars, to near three thousand six hundred twenty.

head: BITCOIN *~$60K*
XRP $0.95 · XDC -2%
scenes.say: Bitcoin is just under sixty thousand, down about one percent. X R P holds near ninety five cents. Stellar is up almost one percent, X D C is down two.

head: THIN MARKET.
*EARLY CLOSE.*
scenes.say: It's Black Friday. Wall Street closes early, volume is thin, and thin markets love to run the obvious stops.

head: A STOP ON THE OBVIOUS LINE
*GETS HUNTED.*
scenes.say: Today's lesson. A stop right on the line everyone sees gets hunted. Next time, it goes beyond the last swing.

head: BTC · XRP · XLM · XDC
*SMALL STEPS. EVERY DAY.*
scenes.say: Our long term watchlist stays the same. Bitcoin, X R P, Stellar and X D C. Price can't move us. We do our part.

head: FREEDOM IS
*BUILT DAILY.*
scenes.say: Day two. Freedom is built daily.
